function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a given command using the os.system() function specifically for Windows operating systems. For multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For complex tasks, create and run a .bat file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The Windows command line instruction(s) to be executed. Use '&&' between commands for multiple instructions. For complex sequences, encapsulate the logic within a .bat file and provide the execution command here.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to a real‑time clock or the ability to look up the current time. If you need the exact time, please check your device’s clock or a reliable online time service.
message.reasoning: The user asks "what is the time". We need to respond with current time. We don't have real-time capability but we can approximate? The system says we cannot access external data. But we can use the current date from the system: 2026-05-19. But time? We don't know. We could say "I don't have real-time clock" or "I can't fetch current time". According to policy, we should not fabricate. So we should say we don't have real-time capability.
